# How many 2-tops, 4-tops and 6-tops should my restaurant have?

> Free restaurant table mix tool: enter your floor area, table sizes and party-size mix, and get the number of 2-tops, 4-tops and 6-tops that seats the most guests, from simulated busy services. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/dining-room-table-mix-optimizer/)

## Limits

- Up to 600 parties in one busy window. Above that the page asks for one section of the room or a shorter window, because the simulation would take minutes in a browser.

## Source

- [Source code and README](https://github.com/duncan-haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/dining-room-table-mix-optimizer): MIT licensed.
